purpose: Review what is being bought and pay.
layout: Item summary with thumbnails and quantities, then delivery or contact block, then payment method row, then a price breakdown ending in the total. A sticky bottom bar repeats the total with the pay button.

required: Items with thumbnail, name, quantity and price
Sticky pay button with the total

primaryAction.note: "Place order · $29.47" — the total inside or beside the button.

avoid: Totals that do not add up
The pay button above the breakdown
